claims.text: Women’s health remains substantially under-resourced in medical imaging research.

claims.text: Pelvic pathologies like PCOS and pelvic fracture suffer from a scarcity of public, well-annotated benchmark data.
claims.poster_quote: Pelvic pathologies like PCOS and pelvic fracture suffer from a scarcity of public, well-annotated benchmark data.
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: Women’s health remains substantially under-resourced in medical imaging research, with pelvic pathologies such as polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) and pelvic fracture both suffering from a scarcity of public, well-annotated benchmark data despite their clinical importance.
claims.reason: Abstract, page 1: The paper directly states that PCOS and pelvic fracture suffer from a scarcity of public, well-annotated benchmark data.

claims.text: PelviNeXt is a modality-agnostic hybrid architecture for pelvic imaging.
claims.poster_quote: We introduce PelviNeXt, a modality-agnostic hybrid architecture for pelvic imaging.
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: We introduce PelviNeXt, a modality-agnostic hybrid architecture combining a dense convolutional feature extractor, hierarchical channel-spatial attention (H-CBAM), a multi-scale fusion module (MSFM), and talking-heads multi-head self-attention (TH-MHSA), applied without modification to both pelvic ultrasound and X-ray inputs.
claims.reason: Abstract, page 1: The paper explicitly describes PelviNeXt as a modality-agnostic hybrid architecture for pelvic imaging.

claims.text: PelviNeXt combines a dense convolutional feature extractor, hierarchical channel-spatial attention (H-CBAM), a multi-scale fusion module (MSFM), and talking-heads multi-head self-attention (TH-MHSA).
claims.poster_quote: PelviNeXt combines a dense convolutional feature extractor, hierarchical channel-spatial attention (H-CBAM), a multi-scale fusion module (MSFM), and talking-heads multi-head self-attention (TH-MHSA).
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: PelviNeXt comprises four stages: a dense feature extractor (DFE), hierarchical CBAM (H-CBAM) attention after each DFE block, a multi-scale fusion module (MSFM), and a talking-heads multi-head self-attention (TH-MHSA) module, followed by a classification head.
claims.reason: Methodology section, page 3: The paper explicitly lists the components of PelviNeXt.

claims.text: The same pipeline is applied to both ultrasound and X-ray inputs without modification.

claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: The same pipeline with identical hyperparameters is applied to both ultrasound and X-ray inputs.
claims.reason: Methodology section, page 3: The paper explicitly states that the same pipeline is applied to both ultrasound and X-ray inputs without modification.

claims.text: PelviNeXt uses a perceptual-hashing integrity audit to identify extensive near-duplicate contamination in PCOSGen.
claims.poster_quote: Through a perceptual-hashing integrity audit of PCOSGen, we identified extensive near-duplicate contamination and released a deduplicated dataset.
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: We compute a perceptual hash (pHash) for every image and calculate pairwise Hamming distances. [...] Deduplication proceeds in two stages: exact duplicates (distance = 0) are removed first, [...] near-duplicates (distance ≤ 14) are then removed.
claims.reason: PCOSGen Integrity Audit section, page 4: The paper describes the use of a perceptual-hashing integrity audit to identify duplicate and near-duplicate images in PCOSGen.

claims.text: PelviNeXt released a deduplicated version of the PCOSGen dataset.
claims.poster_quote: Through a perceptual-hashing integrity audit of PCOSGen, we identified extensive near-duplicate contamination and released a deduplicated dataset.
claims.label: supported
claims.paper_evidence: The deduplicated dataset is publicly released (see Data Availability).
claims.reason: PCOSGen Integrity Audit section, page 4: The paper explicitly states that the deduplicated version of the PCOSGen dataset was released.
